create_AutoRoundConfig: create an AutoRoundConfig instance with weight_bits, group_size, sym, packing_format, and backend parameters
build_AutoRoundConfig_from_config: build an AutoRoundConfig from a dictionary containing bits, group_size, sym, and backend keys
test_get_layer_config: test the get_layer_config method to resolve per-layer quantization bits, group_size, and symmetry
run_apply_awq_quant_layer: run apply_awq_quant_layer to apply AWQ or AWQ-Marlin quantization to a linear or MoE layer
run_apply_gptq_quant_layer: run apply_gptq_quant_layer to apply GPTQ or GPTQ-Marlin quantization to a linear or MoE layer
